title: Nutrient-rich Norwegian Jerusalem Artichokes Stew
description: A simple and flavorful stew made with roasted Jerusalem artichokes, pork belly, and vegetables, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Season the pork belly with salt and pepper.
Roast the pork belly in the oven for 20 minutes, or until browned.
Heat the coconut oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onions and sauté for 5 minutes, or until softened.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes and sauté for 5 minutes.
Add the chopped Jerusalem artichokes and sauté for 5 minutes.
Add the roasted pork belly, chicken broth, and pork stock to the pot.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Use a spoon to mash some of the potatoes and Jerusalem artichokes against the side of the pot to thicken the stew.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
